findings.description: Edit links are only 29x20 px on a 360px phone layout, far below the touch target size; they sit next to the 34px Delete button, so taps can miss or hit Delete.
repro: Sign in as editor at 360px width

findings.description: Every row has identical Edit and Delete controls with no row-specific accessible name, so screen reader users cannot tell which expense a control acts on.
repro: Tab through the Edit and Delete controls

notes: Totals, filter, add and edit pages looked correct. Did not submit or delete data.
